root_idea.summary: The root centers on passing one thing over another in a spreading or wiping motion.
root_idea.development: From this core arise wiping and removing, applying or anointing, measuring or traversing a surface, marking or flattening, and figurative extensions such as striking with a sword.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the verbal noun مَسْحٌ, the citation form corresponding to the Quranic accusative مَسْحًا.

senses.definition: To pass the hand over something, wiping it or removing moisture, dirt, or another surface trace.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic imperative occurs in purification instructions; the construction may specify the body part being wiped and the medium used.

senses.definition: In ritual purification, to wipe or pass water over designated body parts; in this construction, the verb is also recorded with the extended sense “to wash.”
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested ritual construction, especially مَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ and the wording of the purification passage in which the head and feet are mentioned.

senses.definition: Wiping or passing the hand over something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is in an expression that has been understood as the physical passing of the hand over the horses.

senses.definition: Striking or cutting with a sword, by figurative extension from wiping or passing over; in the Quranic expression, striking or cutting the horses’ legs and necks.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the explicitly Quran-attested sword-related interpretation of the occurrence; the same passage is also reported with the physical-wiping interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compass the Sacred House, traditionally by passing the hand over its Black Stone corner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional ritual expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove an affliction from someone; in a prayer, to cleanse or relieve the person of illness or sins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A supplicatory idiom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To anoint a person or thing with oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use with the anointed object as complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be marked or characterized by a quality, especially nobility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To comb and dress the hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical synonym of combing or arranging hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stroke the beards as a sign of reconciliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional social gesture rather than a separate physical action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beguile or deceive someone with pleasant words while giving him nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom involving deceptive reassurance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie or utter what is false.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical figurative use distinct from merely flattering or beguiling someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set forth and travel through the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive construction describing movement across a region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass lightly by people or brush past them without remaining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative movement expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the inner thighs, or the inner side of the knee, to rub and become sore or chapped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive bodily condition; this is distinct from the transitive wiping verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make camels travel all day, with the associated result of saddle injury and emaciation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized use applied to driving pack camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To measure or survey land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical or figurative extension involving the measured extent of a surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or cut someone with a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general sword construction; the Quran-specific occurrence is represented separately under مَسْحٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slay people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of striking or cutting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To create someone blessed and goodly, or, conversely, accursed and foul or ugly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed theological or descriptive use of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach sexually or have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A euphemistic conventional use; no object-class restriction is implied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take someone by the hand and place one’s palm against his palm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or interpersonal hand-contact construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a compact or covenant with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension of striking or joining palms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use blandishing or wheedling words toward one another, deceptively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal figurative construction in which the speakers’ hearts are not sincere.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wash oneself with water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive Form V construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform the ablution known as الوضوء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional ritual use of the reflexive form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform tayammum, ritual purification using the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized ritual construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make the forehead touch the ground in prostration without an intervening object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct interpretation of the same earth-related construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek blessing through contact with, or approach to, an excellent or devout person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or devotional use involving the person or his garment as a means of seeking blessing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have nothing in one’s possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom comparing the person to one who wipes his arms and finds them empty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wipe oneself clean of something, or to wipe oneself with something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The complement may be introduced as the thing removed or the thing used for wiping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act toward one another in a friendly or sincere manner, or to take one another by the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a contract or bargain with one another, confirming it by striking palms and swearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension of reciprocal hand-clasping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw a sword from its scabbard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII specialized usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A coarse or thick hair-cloth garment, mat, or worn-out hair-cloth covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun distinct from the verbal noun meaning wiping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or middle part of a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the roadway’s central track.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Paucity of flesh in the buttocks or thighs, including small buttocks that stick together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A visible trace, sign, mark, or trait of a quality, especially beauty, nobility, or leanness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually used in a phrase meaning that someone shows some such quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anointed or wiped over with oil; by extension, the anointed one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This adjective and noun also underlie the title al-Masīḥ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Messiah or Christ, especially Jesus; with a qualifier, the false Messiah or Antichrist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The unqualified title normally refers to Jesus, while الدجّال or الكذّاب specifies the false Messiah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A king.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported Classical meaning of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sweat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained by its being wiped away when it pours forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A coin whose impression has been obliterated or erased.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a blank or impressionless coin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of silver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the erased-coin sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One-eyed, or having one side of the face plain without an eye or eyebrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical description traditionally applied, among others, to the false Messiah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rough napkin, kerchief, or cloth used for wiping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Named from its use in wiping the face or retaining dirt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful in the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who journeys or goes about much as a devotee.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A devotional or ascetic description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who has frequent sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independent adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Greatly erring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of persistent error.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great liar, one who lies much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use distinct from the title al-Masīḥ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very veracious or truthful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare or possibly obsolete adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Created blessed and goodly, or, conversely, accursed, foul, or unfortunate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive passive sense related to being created with blessing or misfortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The measurement or surveying of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lock, portion, or plait of hair, especially hair hanging from the head or left undressed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is مَسَائِحُ; the term may also denote the part of the head or cheek touched by the hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow, especially an excellent bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun distinct from the hair term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measurer or surveyor of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun derived from measuring land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mild chafing on a camel’s breast callosity or armpit, caused by rubbing, without bleeding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized camel-related noun or descriptive expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great slayer, one who slays many.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agentive adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who combs and dresses hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine agent noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flat, smooth, usually barren tract with small stones; a smooth waterless desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The masculine and feminine forms can function substantivally for this type of terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Red land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A terrain description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman with little flesh in the buttocks and thighs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical feminine adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who is foul, ugly, or unseemly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported descriptive use of the feminine adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man with a flat sole lacking a hollow, or with smooth, soft feet without cracks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical adjective concerning the feet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose breast has little or no bulk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical feminine adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A one-eyed woman, or a woman with a defective eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man with little flesh in the buttocks and thighs, or with small buttocks that stick together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical masculine adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose inner thighs rub together and become sore, or whose knee is inflamed by garment friction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical masculine adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mounted hostile raid that passes lightly by the opposing party without remaining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long piece of wood in a ship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nautical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having small buttocks cleaving closely to the bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive passive participial expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A eunuch whose testicles have been removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An upper arm with little flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive bodily expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that is foul, ugly, unfortunate, or changed from its proper form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive passive participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dissembler or deceiver who blandishes and beguiles with words; also an audacious, wicked, or great liar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare descriptive noun or adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The crocodile, a large aquatic animal that seizes and devours prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun with plural forms تَمَاسِيحُ and تَمَاسِحُ.
